question: Can generic proof witness and execute session declaration choices without inventing a board action or terminal?
scope: Optional research-only GameSession AND/OR tree; actual GameSession.submit/declare/result; board actions and ALL owned declarations including losing claims. Resignation omitted as dominated for a forced-win query; no claim about strategic restart values.
bounds: No engine/train/game batch; focused finite fixtures max8192nodes/3s/proof, maxdepth8; independent verifier replays public session record on every edge; no Core/product/default changes.
decision: If a real defender RESTART refutes an otherwise board-win proof, session choices are necessary for generality. Real WIN must produce SessionStatus.DECLARATION with unchanged Core GameState. Preserve existing unsupported guards; this is opt-in separate certificate type.
